definitions.explanation: A visual representation displayed on a screen or printed on paper. Covers photographs, illustrations, diagrams, and any digital or physical image.

examples.japanese: この{画像|がぞう}はきれいだ。
{画像|がぞう}をクリックして{拡大|かくだい}してください。
examples.english: Please click on the image to enlarge it.

examples.japanese: SNSにアップロードする{前|まえ}に、{画像|がぞう}のサイズを{確認|かくにん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should check the image size before uploading it to social media.

notes:
USAGE:
{画像|がぞう} is the standard word for images in digital and print contexts. It covers photographs, illustrations, screenshots, and any visual file.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画像|がぞう}を{保存|ほぞん}する (save an image)
- {画像|がぞう}を{編集|へんしゅう}する (edit an image)
- {画像|がぞう}を{検索|けんさく}する (search for images)
- {画像|がぞう}{処理|しょり} (image processing)
- {高画質|こうがしつ}の{画像|がぞう} (high-quality image)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {写真|しゃしん}: photograph (specifically photos taken with a camera)
- {映像|えいぞう}: video, footage (moving images)
- {絵|え}: drawing, painting (hand-created images)
